item.title: Give the Agent a Desk, Not Your Keys
item.description: You would never give a new hire root on the machine holding your keys. Kagebox is an experiment in giving an autonomous agent a whole machine that is not yours: its own kernel, credentials that stay host side, a latch it cannot reach, and a spend cap. Every layer of it failed open at least once, and that turned out to be the lesson.
